```{python}
# "Latest writing": built from soccer_articles.yml on every render, so it never goes stale.
import html
from datetime import date

import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, display

OUTLET_SERIES = {"Equalizer Soccer": 1, "ESPN": 2, "Backheeled": 3, "American Soccer Analysis": 4}

raw = yaml.safe_load(open("soccer_articles.yml", encoding="utf-8"))
articles = sorted(
    (a for a in raw.values() if a.get("published_url") and a.get("title")),
    key=lambda a: str(a["date"]),
    reverse=True,
)


def card(a):
    d = date.fromisoformat(str(a["date"]))
    outlet = a.get("publisher") or ""
    return f"""
    <li class="ac-article">
      <div class="ac-article-meta">
        <time datetime="{d.isoformat()}">{d:%b} {d.day}, {d.year}</time>
        <span class="ac-outlet"><span class="ac-dot" data-series="{OUTLET_SERIES.get(outlet, 1)}" aria-hidden="true"></span>{html.escape(outlet)}</span>
      </div>
      <h3><a href="{html.escape(a['published_url'], quote=True)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{html.escape(a['title'])}</a></h3>
      <p>{html.escape(a.get('description') or '')}</p>
    </li>"""


display(HTML(f"""
<section class="ac-section" aria-labelledby="ac-latest-title">
  <div class="ac-section-title">
    <h2 id="ac-latest-title">Latest writing</h2>
    <a href="soccer.html">All {len(articles)} articles <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
  </div>
  <ol class="ac-article-list ac-article-grid">{''.join(card(a) for a in articles[:3])}</ol>
</section>
"""))
```
